propositions: Criteria assembly failures (CriteriaError) are incorrectly routed through the LLM degradation tail and marked as llm_unavailable=true even when no LLM call executed.

The generic workflow interpreter loses typed exception identity by recording only string representations, preventing downstream verdict dispatch from distinguishing criteria config faults from genuine LLM/provider failures.

Verdict dispatch must catch the structured CriteriaError at the assemble boundary before generic degradation and emit a dedicated config-fault INDETERMINATE verdict with actionable diagnostics naming the installed build as suspect.
The config-fault verdict must preserve deterministic findings and coverage, omit affirmative llm_unavailable, and direct operators to use repository checkout build.
Genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider controls must remain behaviorally unchanged; deterministic blockers must stay BLOCK rather than masked by INDETERMINATE.
